ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; the visible surface is characterized by a high dominance of low-intensity pixels (dark pigmentation) with high-intensity pixels (white) appearing only in localized clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) contiguous mapping across approximately 98% of the visible surface; high-contrast white geometric blobs are restricted to the far lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 45 degrees, centered at the mid-point of the fluke’s horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys of 1-4 pixels) distributed uniformly along the continuous linear boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, following an upward and outward arc toward the terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the far-left and far-right distal tips, indicating concentrated surface disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the distal margins of both fluke lobes.
